releaseNotes:
CineMovie v0.8.9

Added:
• Videasy stream provider: Added multi-resolution stream parsing (4K, 2K, 1080p, 720p, 480p) with SpeedRaceLight cipher decryption and automated CDN failover.
• Stremio add-on support: Added stream and subtitle integration for Torrentio, CyberFlix, Cinemeta, and custom manifests with configurable 'Subtitles Only' mode.
• Background downloads: Added native Android foreground service downloader with progress notifications and MediaStore gallery export.
• Safety confirmations: Added confirmation dialogs for profile deletion, add-on uninstallation, and watch history clearing.
• Network fallbacks: Added automated proxy fallback for TMDB API and image assets in restricted network environments.

Subtitles:
• Subtitle categorization: Separated subtitle tracks into Official Server Subtitles, Available Backup Subtitles (OpenSubtitles v3 & YTS), and Community Add-on Subtitles (GTSubs).
• DOM subtitle renderer: Replaced React state updates with direct DOM node manipulation for subtitle cues during playback.
• Native subtitle resolvers: Implemented Kotlin proxy endpoints for OpenSubtitles v3, YTS ZIP extraction, and TMDb-to-IMDb ID resolution.

Video Player & Playback:
• Display refresh rate: Configured Android window display mode to prevent 24Hz refresh rate downclocking during video playback.
• Episode transitions: Implemented complete HLS instance disposal and timestamp reset to 0:00 on episode switch.
• Timer optimization: Scoped playback progress timers to active controls overlay state to minimize background re-renders.
• Quality selection: Directly exposed available HLS stream quality tiers (4K, 2K, 1080p, 720p, 480p) without synthetic placeholders.

Android TV:
• D-pad navigation: Implemented direct-path remote focus routing to reduce layout reflows on D-pad input.
• Settings panel: Updated player settings side drawer with native white focus outline.
• Focus handling: Disabled touch scroll-snapping on Android TV mode to prevent focus jumping on rapid D-pad input.

Fixed:
• Mobile player gestures: Fixed touch gesture coordinate handling for brightness, volume, 2X speed, and screen lock controls.
• Playback startup: Fixed stream startup playback hang at 0:00.
• Stream scrapers: Fixed mobile stream extraction for VidSrc Top and CloudNestra.
• Password reset: Fixed URL routing to redirect to production web domain.
• Android TV startup: Fixed black screen on initial app launch.

Improved & Performance:
• Syncing: Improved real-time watch history and playback progress synchronization across profiles.
• Downloader: Improved download throughput using parallel multi-connection segment resolution.
• HLS Handling: Improved M3U8 manifest parser and CDN failover handling.
• DOM Performance: Reduced initial DOM footprint by lazy-mounting inactive tabs.
• Asset Caching: Optimized image caching and hero section asset loading.
